explication: go-elasticsearch is the official Go client for Elasticsearch. A Go application configures the client, selects a low-level or typed API operation, and sends an HTTP request to an Elasticsearch cluster; typed query builders can help assemble request bodies. The client also exposes broad API families for search, document updates, ingest, security, and cluster operations, plus documented bulk-indexing and observability capabilities. The graph groups generated endpoints by domain rather than listing every operation. Sampled request code shows transport-backed API calls; links between client setup and endpoint families follow the README’s documented usage, not inspected root wiring.
